fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the vector store.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: Object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `vector_store`.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the vector store was created.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the vector store.

fields.name: UsageBytes
fields.description: The total number of bytes used by the files in the vector store.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The status of the vector store, which can be either `expired`, `in_progress`, or `completed`. A status of `completed` indicates that the vector store is ready for use.
